This product may be supplied with either a blue or black tube holder. This is a cosmetic difference only — all other product features and performance remain unchanged.

Heavy-duty, professional-quality chemical anchor resin gun specifically designed for use with 380ml - 420ml cartridges. Pushes the resin through the mixing nozzle with ease. Generates high pressure for extrusion of 2-part resin components, whilst ensuring an even pressure with minimal effort.
